10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:e688f787-9daf-47.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced innovation director, corporate innovator, or AI thought leader who instinctively spots gaps in logic and understands the real-world complexities of innovation strategy? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main role or projects? Join us to shape how AI learns, interprets, and applies innovation expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are searching for experienced innovation professionals based in the EU or UK to enhance the depth, accuracy, and practical relevance of AI-powered innovation and business transformation solutions. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs on innovation topics, such as strategic innovation, business model design, organizational change, product development, and scaling innovation. - Evaluate AI content for commercial realism, strategic logic, and relevance to true innovation challenges. - Draft realistic scenarios and case studies that reflect your hands-on experience driving innovation in real organizations. - Create scenario variations from multiple stakeholder perspectives (e.g. innovation director, product lead, C-suite, board member). - Identify gaps, flawed assumptions, or impracticality in AI-generated innovation content. In simple terms: You will review and improve AI-generated innovation content, ensuring it reflects authentic expertise and practical solutions. Instead of delivering traditional innovation consulting, you’ll apply your real-world experience to help AI systems deeply understand and reason about delivering successful innovation at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level innovation director, innovation lead, strategy consultant, or business transformation leader. - Based in and eligible to work in the EU or UK. - Several years of hands-on experience in driving innovation, business model transformation, or leading change initiatives. - Strong ability to spot weak logic, theoretical gaps, or unrealistic assumptions in innovation reasoning. - Comfortable working independently and providing clear, concise feedback. - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with immediate or near-term availability. Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote work that fits your schedule. - Apply your innovation expertise in a cutting-edge AI environment. - Directly contribute to shaping the next generation of AI systems. - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to develop your AI skillset. - Structured onboarding, clear project briefs, and the opportunity for ongoing collaboration. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. collective-collective:ashbyhq:7f7866f5-7.description: About Collective: Collective is on a mission to redefine the way businesses-of-one work. Our technology and team of trusted advisors help members achieve financial independence by taking care of everything from business incorporation to accounting, bookkeeping, tax services, and access to a thriving community, all in one integrated platform. We believe in empowering self-employed people to enjoy the same tax savings that big companies get, so they can focus on their passion, not paperwork. Featured in Forbes, Business Insider, Yahoo, Bloomberg, Financial Times, TechCrunch, and more. We are backed by General Catalyst, Sound Ventures (Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary), QED Investors, Google’s Gradient Ventures, Expa, and other investors who have financed iconic companies like YouTube, Substack, Twitch, Box, Hims, Instacart, and Lyft. About the role: We’re hiring a Director of Engineering to build and evolve the core product experiences that power Collective’s member platform. This is an engineering leadership role with high ownership across Product, Design, and Operations to lead the teams to ship fast and iterate based on real customer needs. You’ll be expected to encourage the use of modern AI tools and agent-based workflows to accelerate development, improve code quality, and unlock new product capabilities. What you'll do: - Act as a player-coach, balancing hands-on technical contribution and people leadership - Lead, mentor, and grow managers and leaders, fostering a culture of high-performance and empathy. - Work with teams of talented engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver a robust platform. - Define, own, and ensure the timely delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary, and highly visible engineering projects. - Drive clarity about architecture, design, and product decisions across teams, utilizing full-stack capability (e.g., Python/Django backend, React frontend). - Manage team processes and interface effectively with non-technical stakeholders, including Operations teams. - Contribute to engineering-wide initiatives and drive conversations from engineering teams to executive leadership. What you'll bring: - 8-10+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4+ years of management experience. - Technical depth to drive end-to-end systems ownership, including architecture, design, and data modeling. - Demonstrated success in operating as a player-coach, maintaining hands-on technical proficiency. - Experience managing a team that has delivered a great product with solid foundations. - Organizational leadership experience, including experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders and weighing tradeoffs. - A track record of encouraging a healthy work environment that is both supportive and challenging. What we offer: - Hybrid Work Model: Based in San Francisco with a balance of in-office and remote flexibility. - Fresh Lunch: Provided on in-office days. - Commuter Support: $150 monthly reimbursement for transit expenses. - Health & Wellness: $200 quarterly reimbursement to support your well-being. - Time Off: Flexible PTO plus 14 company holidays. - Comprehensive Coverage: 100% medical, dental, and vision for employees; 75% coverage for dependents. - Parental Leave: 16 weeks fully paid. - Retirement & Ownership: 401k plan plus an equity package. - Team Connection: Quarterly virtual events and an annual in-person summit.

Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As an Assistant Store Manager at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by assisting a high-performing retail team that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. The Assistant Store Manager helps cultivate a positive store culture focused on #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:330bfe8e-44.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. OPERATIONS We're passionate about operational excellence, acting with our customers and partners always in our heart. Covering the entire order journey, we create our online content, secure payments and fraud process compliance, ensure order fulfilment and delivery, while providing customer and partner care. In a nutshell, we love to create seamless and memorable luxury experiences for our customers all around the world. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. ROLE We are looking for a highly motivated individual with exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and a passion for learning. In this role, you’ll play a key part in maximizing our online catalogue by identifying gaps, streamlining processes, and driving data-informed decisions. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our catalogue is as comprehensive, accurate, and efficient as possible. This is a unique opportunity to have a direct impact on our growth by ensuring customers have access to as much of our catalogue online as possible. You’ll work in a dynamic environment with smart, collaborative colleagues and plenty of room to grow your skills and career.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c9669ac-fee3-.title: Business Operations Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c9669ac-fee3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Operations Manager based in Spain. As Business Operations Manager, you’ll play a central role in ensuring commercial operations run smoothly across the EMEA region. You’ll act as the operational bridge between Commercial, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, HQ Operations, and external partners. Your scope will span the full commercial lifecycle, from quotations and orders through provisioning, invoicing, renewals, and partner operations. This is an independent, hands-on role where you’ll own issues, coordinate stakeholders, and drive solutions rather than simply provide administrative support. You’ll help identify operational bottlenecks and turn recurring challenges into scalable, standardized processes. Working in a fast-growing healthcare technology environment, you’ll have meaningful exposure to international markets and cross-functional initiatives. The role offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact on operational efficiency while helping support continued expansion across EMEA. Manage quotations and orders by preparing quotes and order forms, reviewing purchase orders, coordinating approvals, and ensuring accurate handovers between Commercial and operational teams. Coordinate order processing and license provisioning, ensuring customer and partner information is complete and resolving operational blockers efficiently. Support invoicing and accounts receivable activities by ensuring invoice readiness, coordinating with Finance, monitoring invoice status and overdue receivables, and resolving billing or documentation issues. Manage renewal operations by maintaining visibility of upcoming renewals, coordinating preparation across relevant teams and partners, and proactively tracking risks and outstanding actions. Support distributor and commercial partner operations, including onboarding, documentation, system access, internal setup, and alignment with operational processes. Coordinate operational requirements for new EMEA markets, working across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Regulatory, Customer Success, and HQ teams. Take ownership of day-to-day commercial operational issues by establishing clear owners and deadlines, coordinating stakeholders, removing bottlenecks, and driving matters through to resolution. Identify recurring operational challenges and develop scalable processes that improve turnaround times, reduce rework, and minimize unnecessary escalations to senior management. Monitor operational performance through metrics such as order-processing times, provisioning lead times, renewal readiness, partner onboarding, AR follow-up, and completion of agreed actions. Requirements: Approximately 4–7 years of experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Order Management, or a related operational role. Experience supporting B2B commercial operations, preferably across multiple countries or international markets. Strong understanding of quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, renewals, and order-to-cash processes. Proven ability to coordinate effectively across Commercial, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Operations, and external stakeholders. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and reliable follow-through. Comfortable working independently and taking initiative in a fast-growing, evolving environment where processes may still be developing. Experience using CRM platforms and other business systems to manage operational workflows and information. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and geographies. Experience in SaaS, healthcare, medical devices, healthcare IT, or another technology-driven environment is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn operational issues into practical, repeatable solutions. Benefits: Full-time

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:145aea1e-177.title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - German (Germany)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:145aea1e-177.description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level German (Germany) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level German (Germany) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $48.00 USD per hour
